questions.text: Arrange the following coordination compounds in the increasing order of magnetic moments. (Atomic numbers: $\mathrm{Mn}=25 ; \mathrm{Fe}=26$ )

options.D:
$\left[\mathrm{Mn}(\mathrm{CN})_{6}\right]^{3-}$
(A) A $<$ B $<$ D $<$ C
(B) B $<$ D $<$ C $<$ A
(C) A $<$ C $<$ D $<$ B
(D) B $<$ D $<$ A $<$ C

Official Ans. by NTA (B)
Ans. (B)
Sol. (A) $\left[\mathrm{FeF}_{6}\right]^{3-}$
$$\begin{array}{l}
\mathrm{Fe}^{+3} \rightarrow 3 \mathrm{~d}^{5} 4 \mathrm{~s}^{0} \\
\mathrm{n}=5
\end{array}$$
(B) $\left[\mathrm{Fe}(\mathrm{CN})_{6}\right]^{3-}$
<smiles>CC(Br)C1CC1</smiles>
$$\begin{array}{l}
\mathrm{Fe}^{+3} \rightarrow 3 \mathrm{~d}^{5} 4 \mathrm{~s}^{0} \\
\mathrm{n}=1
\end{array}$$
(C) $\left[\mathrm{MnCl}_{6}\right]^{3-}$
<smiles>C[CH]([Ga])C(C)C1CC1</smiles>
$$\begin{array}{l}
\mathrm{Mn}^{+3} \rightarrow 3 \mathrm{~d}^{4} 4 \mathrm{~s}^{0} \\
\mathrm{n}=4
\end{array}$$
(D) $\left[\mathrm{Mn}(\mathrm{CN})_{6}\right]^{3-}$
<smiles>C[CH]([Ga])C1CC1</smiles>
$$\begin{array}{l} 
\mathrm{Mn}^{+3} \rightarrow 3 \mathrm{~d}^{4} 4 \mathrm{~s}^{0} \\
\mathrm{n}=2 \\
\mu \Rightarrow \mathrm{~A}>\mathrm{C}>\mathrm{D}>\mathrm{B}
\end{array}$$

questions.text: 116 g of a substance upon dissociation reaction, yields 7.5 g of hydrogen, 60 g of oxygen and 48.5 g of carbon. Given that the atomic masses of H, O and C are 1, 16 and 12 respectively. The data agrees with how many formulae of the following?

options.D:
$\mathrm{CH}_{3} \mathrm{CHO}$

Official Ans. by NTA (2)
Ans. (2)
Sol. $\% \mathrm{H}=\frac{7.5}{116} \times 100=6.5$
$$\begin{array}{l}
\% \mathrm{O}=\frac{60}{116} \times 100=51.7 \\
\% \mathrm{C}=\frac{48.5}{116} \times 100=41.8
\end{array}$$

Relative atomicities $=\mathrm{H} \Rightarrow 6.5$
$$\begin{array}{l}
\mathrm{O} \Rightarrow \frac{51.7}{16}=3.25 \\
\mathrm{C} \Rightarrow \frac{41.8}{12}=3.5
\end{array}$$
